```ruby
class Cache
  def initialize(packer: nil)
    @packer = packer
    @store = {}
  end

  def write(key, payload, stale: false)
    entry = { payload: payload, stale: stale }
    if @packer
      serialized = @packer.dump(entry)
      @store[key] = serialized
    else
      @store[key] = entry
    end
  end

  def read(key)
    entry = @store[key]
    return nil if entry.nil?

    if @packer
      entry = @packer.load(entry)
    end

    entry[:payload]
  end

  def sweep
    keys_to_remove = []
    @store.each do |key, entry|
      if @packer
        deserialized = @packer.load(entry)
        if deserialized[:stale]
          keys_to_remove << key
        end
      else
        if entry[:stale]
          keys_to_remove << key
        end
      end
    end
    keys_to_remove.each { |key| @store.delete(key) }
  end
end
```

```ruby
class Weight
  include Comparable

  attr_reader :amount, :unit

  def initialize(amount, unit)
    @amount = amount
    @unit = unit
  end

  def <=>(other)
    unless other.is_a?(Weight)
      raise ArgumentError, "can only compare Weight with Weight"
    end
    unless @unit == other.unit
      raise ArgumentError, "can only compare Weights with the same unit"
    end
    @amount <=> other.amount
  end

  def ==(other)
    return false unless other.is_a?(Weight)
    @unit == other.unit && @amount == other.amount
  end

  def clamp(min = 0, max = nil)
    # Ruby's Object#clamp behavior: if min and max given, clamp between them
    # If only min given, it's a lower bound
    # We need to handle the Weight-specific clamping
    if min.is_a?(Weight)
      unless @unit == min.unit
        raise ArgumentError, "can only clamp Weights with the same unit"
      end
      if max
        unless max.is_a?(Weight)
          raise ArgumentError, "max must be a Weight"
        end
        unless @unit == max.unit
          raise ArgumentError, "can only clamp Weights with the same unit"
        end
        if @amount < min.amount
          return Weight.new(min.amount, @unit)
        elsif @amount > max.amount
          return Weight.new(max.amount, @unit)
        else
          return self
        end
      else
        if @amount < min.amount
          return Weight.new(min.amount, @unit)
        else
          return self
        end
      end
    else

      super
    end
  end

  def between?(start, finish)
    unless start.is_a?(Weight) && finish.is_a?(Weight)

      super
      return
    end

  end

  end

  end
```
